# Kydos Digital

> Kydos Digital Ltd is a digital marketing agency based in Oldham, Greater Manchester, UK (Regus, Chapel Road, Oldham OL8 4QQ; company number 16290693). It connects social media, SEO, paid media, websites, CRM, marketing automation and reporting around business growth for clients across Greater Manchester.

Contact: Support@kydosdigital.com · +44 7450 555205

## Free tools

- [Free marketing tools for small businesses](https://www.kydosdigital.com/tools/): Index of free, no-sign-up tools from Kydos Digital.
- [Google Review Link & QR Code Generator](https://www.kydosdigital.com/tools/google-review-link-generator.html): Creates a direct Google review link (https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=PLACE_ID) and a printable QR code from a business's Google Place ID.
- [UTM Link Builder](https://www.kydosdigital.com/tools/utm-builder.html): Builds tracked links with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and utm_content, with presets for Google Business Profile, social, email and print.
